concept.title: Continuous manual mode
concept.shortdesc: Continuous manual mode allows you to shift gears continuously by pulling the paddle shifters..

li.p: To activate continuous manual mode, turn and hold the shift lever toward D (Drive). The M (Manual mode) indicator appears on the instrument cluster.
To shift gears, pull the right (+) or left (-) paddle shifter after activating continuous manual mode.

To return to automatic shift mode, move the gear shift lever to D (Drive), or pull and hold the right (+) paddle shifter for more than 1 second. The D (Drive) indicator appears on the instrument cluster.

section.title: Operating conditions
section.p: Continuous manual mode operates under the following conditions:

li.p: If you pull both paddle shifters at the same time or pull the right (+) paddle shifter while pulling the left (-) paddle shifter, you cannot shift gears.
Avoid sudden braking and rapid acceleration, as they may damage the vehicle. Shift gears according to the road conditions and vehicle speed.
